description_en: Invokes ListNodeGroupTransferPackets to retrieve the statistics information of uplink and downlink packets for a node group
description_zh: 调用ListNodeGroupTransferPackets获取节点分组上下行数据包的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-node-group-transfer-packets --node-group-id 123 --dev-eui 0000000000000001 --category UPLINK_PACKET --page-number 1 --page-size 2 --begin-millis 1514736000000 --end-millis 1514736000000 --sorting-field LOG_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeGroupTransferPackets

parameters.help_en:
The packet category. Valid values:

DOWNLINK_PACKET: downlink packet
UPLINK_PACKET: uplink packet
parameters.help_zh:
数据包分类。取值：

DOWNLINK_PACKET：下行包
UPLINK_PACKET：上行包
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. Valid values: LOG_MILLIS, which sorts results by time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，取值：LOG_MILLIS，表示按照时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true specifies ascending order, and a value of false specifies descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending
